items.q: Why not just use the Git CLI?
items.a: You can — that's the point. GitPersona doesn't replace Git; it automates the parts around it. Conditional includes, SSH host aliases, and credential helpers all work, but they're fragile, per-machine, and easy to get subtly wrong. GitPersona manages the same standard mechanisms with validation on top, so a mistake becomes impossible rather than merely unlikely.
No. GitPersona only writes standard Git configuration (user.name, user.email, signing keys) and SSH/credential settings. It never touches your working tree, history, or remotes.

items.q: Can I use multiple GitHub accounts?
items.a: Yes — that's the core use case. Each profile carries its own GitHub credentials and SSH key. GitPersona routes each repository to the right account automatically, so personal, work, and client accounts coexist on one machine without conflicts.

No. Your profiles, keys, tokens, and repository mappings never leave your machine, and secrets stay in your OS keychain. GitPersona only goes online to check for updates and announcements and, if you choose to sign in, to verify your plan. Signing in stores your email, your plan, and the devices you sign in on (computer name, OS, and app version). There's no telemetry.
Completely. Switching identities, mapping repositories, managing keys, and applying rules all happen locally. GitPersona does not require a network connection for any core functionality.
Yes. The Free plan includes every feature for up to 3 Git identities, needs no account, and never expires. {{proStatus}}
No. GitPersona works fully without an account, including offline. Signing in, with a one-time code sent to your email, is only needed to start a Pro trial or buy Pro.

faq.a: Not for Free. Free works signed out and fully offline. You only sign in, with a one-time code sent to your email, to start a trial or buy Pro.

faq.q: What counts toward the Free limit?
faq.a: Git identities (profiles) and pinned repositories. Free includes {{profiles}} identities and up to {{repos}} pinned repositories per identity. Repositories you only scan don't count, and rules, SSH keys, credentials, and everything else are unlimited on every plan.

faq.q: I already use GitPersona. Will anything be locked?
faq.a: No. Everything you set up before Pro launches keeps working on Free, including profiles and pinned repositories beyond the Free limits. The limits only apply to new ones.
Nothing is deleted. You choose which {{profiles}} profiles stay active; the rest become read-only until you renew. Repositories already pinned keep their identity in .git/config.
No. Pro is prepaid for a month or a year, and you buy again to extend it. Renewing early adds to the time you have left, so you never lose days.

faq.q: How many devices can use Pro?
faq.a: Up to {{devices}} per account. The desktop app and the CLI on the same machine count as one device. You can deactivate a device from Settings → Account.
Yes. GitPersona checks your license in the background and keeps Pro active for up to 30 days without a connection.

faq.q: Can I use Pro with only the CLI?
faq.a: Yes. Run gitpersona login to sign in, gitpersona upgrade to buy, and gitpersona plan to see your plan. Signing in on the CLI also signs in the desktop app on that machine.

faq.q: Which price list applies to me?
faq.a: The Indonesia price list is for buyers billed in Indonesia. Everyone else pays the International price. You choose when you check out.
Yes. You can get a full refund within {{refundDays}} days of purchase, for any reason. See the Refund Policy.
